summary: Distribute one read-only runtime skill through native Claude and Codex plugin marketplaces.
reason: Installing a binary and leaving instructions inside its clone does not make that CLI discoverable in unrelated new chats. Opt-in native user-level plugin installation supplies discovery without hooks, MCP registration, credential copying, or changes to remote behavior.
validated_outcome: Installer fixtures cover explicit host selection, repeat installation, verification-only isolation, and partial failure. Native isolated host profiles accept and enable the shared plugin. Claude fresh-chat discovery is tested with a synthetic local model response; live model selection and account reads remain manual acceptance. Existing credentials remain in the CLI store.
